---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

A clear and concise description of what the problem is, e.g.
"I'm always frustrated when ..." or "web search returns too few sources when ...".

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Note the relevant
pipeline phase if applicable: planning / searching / fetching / drafting /
citing / debating / reviewing / delivering / MCP / CLI / worker.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## How would this be tested?

Ideas for acceptance criteria or a unit/live test that would verify the
feature. Per project convention: unit tests are offline, live tests are
marked `#[ignore]`.

## Additional context

Anything else relevant: links, references, prior discussion, trade-offs.
